head: e06475971

findings.summary: Home line shows only 'Finish setting up Sindri' + '2 of 6 done'. Spec 2.4 says it also names the first not-done step's title and has a 'Continue' control; neither exists (no VM property, no label, no test).
findings.fix: Add SetupViewModel.HomeLineStep (title of first non-finished step) and a Continue label in the line; extend the HomeLine name and the frames test.

findings.summary: Retry_starts_the_refresh_once_... calls RefreshMap once, so it never proves 'one press sends once'. A read already in flight when Retry is pressed lands after ShowWorking, clears the override and brings the button back (second POST possible; only the 409 path saves it).
findings.fix: Test two overlapping RefreshMap calls (gate the fake) expecting RefreshContextMapCalls==1, and a read landing mid-flight; or keep the override until the read that follows the POST.

findings.summary: RunningRefusal matches any SND-JOB-409; spec says 409 WITH runningJob means already running. A 409 without runningJob (e.g. job ended) is shown as 'Already building' and the job is not followed.
findings.fix: Check the runningJob extension if the UI Error carries it; otherwise say the refusal in words.
findings.resolution: to fix (promoted: only a 409 WITH runningJob reads as already building; others are errors)

findings.summary: SetupCodeField 'Error code' duplicates Labels.JobCodeField; SetupNotRunning duplicates SindriNotRunning text.
findings.resolution: to fix (promoted: reuse JobCodeField and SindriNotRunning)

findings.summary: Spec states: Loading is a six-row skeleton; Working chip has PrimaryHover tone and spinner. Build has plain 'Reading setup...' text and Working uses ChipTone.Neutral (same look as To do, word only).
findings.fix: Add a Working tone/glyph (static under reduced motion) and a skeleton, or record as deferred.
findings.resolution: in writing: skeleton and Working spinner with the F3 polish pass

findings.summary: Spec 5 keys: Up/Down move between rows; not implemented (only Expander's own Enter/Space). Header content is all Raw, so the Expander's toggle part may be unnamed to AT beside the Expander's own name.
findings.fix: Add Up/Down handling in SetupChecklist or defer explicitly; check the toggle's name in the automation tree.
findings.resolution: in writing: Up/Down between rows comes with the keys pass

findings.summary: OpenTheFirstStep opens the first unfinished row on any first read, e.g. a running map in running-progress; spec opens only needs-you/failed (and row 1 on a true first run). Also NotFound with existing steps shows 'not available' text above the old rows.
findings.fix: Limit to the first-run case; clear steps (or hide the panel) when IsNotServed.
findings.resolution: in writing: opening a running first step is fine

findings.summary: OpensInApp('ApproveProfile') looks in NeedsYou.Seen.Rows, which Home's Decisions filter trims; profile:drift has no DecisionId so the button flips to terminal copy under that filter.
findings.resolution: to fix (promoted: OpensInApp must read the unfiltered rows)
